budget.note: The budget is a MEASUREMENT. Every excess stop must be dispositioned either as an accepted permanent gate or as a PROPOSED deterministic policy change that has passed security and control-plane review, replay testing, and explicit owner approval. The budget itself authorizes nothing (D-007 S16.7).
